purpose: Teach: 光線/皇后/便秘/中越/河口/未婚/南下/右派

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、レーザー光線を使った犯行を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police handle cases involving laser-weapon crimes, don't they?
lines.style: Careful, methodical phrasing. Slight pause between thought units. Genuinely curious but with a hint of tentativeness—asking as if confirming something he's pieced together. Soft at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、皇后陛下の御行幸警備もされますね
lines.en: And the police provide security for imperial visits as well, don't they?
lines.style: Direct confirmation with measured courtesy. Professional tone, not hurried. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. Slight nod in the voice—he's simply confirming what falls under their jurisdiction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、便秘薬の不正流通を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So with this case involving illegal distribution of laxatives, the police would handle that too?
lines.style: Same careful framework as before. Building a list methodically. A touch of awkwardness—he's checking his understanding against each category. Slightly hesitant emphasis on the example.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、中越地区の災害復興窃盗にも対応します
lines.en: The police also respond to theft cases related to disaster recovery, like in the Chuetsu region.
lines.style: Steady enumeration of responsibilities. Clear, factual delivery. No strain—just laying out the scope of their work. Slightly formal register, befitting an officer explaining jurisdiction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、河口域の不法投棄を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: And illegal dumping in estuary zones—the police monitor that as well?
lines.style: Same hesitant-but-thorough rhythm. He's testing the boundaries of police jurisdiction through examples. Slight lift at the end, genuinely seeking confirmation. Thoughtful pause before 'as well.'

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、未婚男性を狙った詐欺事件も担当します
lines.en: The police handle fraud targeting unmarried men too.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact addition to the list. No condescension, just practical acknowledgment of another category within their purview. Brief, clear. The tone of someone who's seen it all.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、南下する不法越境者を、警察、警戒されますね
lines.en: So illegal border crossers moving south—the police keep watch over that, right?
lines.style: Building momentum through his examples now. Still careful and reflective, but with a bit more confidence. He's mapping something out. The 'right?' at the end is genuine check-in, not rhetorical.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、右派団体の動向もご注視ですね
lines.en: The police also monitor the activities and movements of right-wing groups closely.
lines.style: Precise, careful phrasing on a sensitive topic. No editorializing, just clear statement of fact. Steady eye-contact level. A touch more deliberate than before—this is delicate jurisdiction to explain.
